deviation: The 90-day warranty runs from performance or delivery rather than acceptance, so some or all of it could expire before Arcadia has tested the work. Section 8.4 also adds a blanket disclaimer of all implied warranties, which the playbook does not allow. The re-performance remedy and refund fallback are fine.
suggested_text: 8.1 Each Party represents and warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement. 8.2 Vertex warrants that the Services and Deliverables will be performed with reasonable skill and care and will conform to the applicable SOW. 8.3 If any Services or Deliverables do not conform to this warranty at any time within ninety (90) days after Arcadia's acceptance (the "Warranty Period"), Vertex shall, at its expense and as Arcadia's first remedy, promptly re-perform the Services or correct the Deliverables free of charge. If Vertex cannot do so within a reasonable time, Arcadia may recover the Fees paid for the non-conforming Services or Deliverables, without limiting its other rights under Article 11. 8.4 [Delete. No general disclaimer of implied warranties.]
